## Professional Bio

As a Software Developer, Sofia Botechia Hernandes builds operationally critical web applications that support large brands through major rebranding and restructuring initiatives. Her work focuses on developing systems designed to handle complex architectures and support dynamic content management by non-technical teams through custom visual interfaces and headless CMS panels.

As part of these efforts, she has engineered and maintained digital platforms for major enterprise rebranding initiatives including:
- Amazônia
- Ativos (Banco do Brasil)
- Banco da Amazônia
- Crown
- GCB Investimentos
- Totvs Techfin

Alongside public brand platforms, her work as an AI Engineer involves designing and deploying internal AI automations and workflow tools to accelerate everyday operations across organization sectors. She builds secure, optimized automations—including managed plugins for internal tools, custom multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines, and API integrations—that translate advanced AI capabilities into straightforward product interfaces.
